## Workload

Tomas Brennan completed the grading activity recorded for the review period. The workload comprised 955 reads over 480 hours. This represents a rate of 2.0 per hour. The recorded workload provides a clear basis for considering both the volume of material assessed and the time available for each read. It also supports comparison between activity completed and the quality checks undertaken during the same review.

## Quality

A sample of 79 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 54.4. This result should be considered alongside the overall workload and the checking activity completed. The review provides an opportunity to identify areas where grading decisions may require further discussion or clarification and to maintain a consistent approach across the material assessed.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
